messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: GPU pool 'hotpath-prod' >90% capacity and sustained queue growth. High 429 rate seen on /v1/generate. Paging on-call.
infra-oncall (Abe): Oncall Abe here, ack. Looking at metrics and the autoscaler. Will coordinate.
sre-joan: I'm on it. Pulling autoscaler and tokenbucket logs now. Suspect autoscaler hit max_capacity and tokenbucket policy started hard-throttling tiers.
ml-runtime: Queue length: 12,400 requests (5m avg 3.4k). Median latency spiked from 120ms -> 3.2s, tail up to 15s. 429s reported across free/standard tiers. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/r/ABCD (posted)
eng-ryan: FYI we rolled out the new tier-to-token mapping at 14:05 UTC (small change to regen units). Could be related.
product-ops: How many customers impacted? any paying customers seeing significant errors?
infra-oncall (Abe): Preliminary: ~7% of total requests 429 at peak, most heavy-streaming customers hit higher failure rates. Top hit clusters: alpha-stream, beta-search. Will fetch per-tenant errors.
sre-joan: Autoscaler logs:
```
2026-03-15T14:12:03Z scale_manager: desired=92 current=92 max_capacity=92 reached_max, cannot scale
2026-03-15T14:12:04Z tokenbucket: tier=standard spend=1.2u/req regen=0.01u/s insufficient_tokens -> 429
2026-03-15T14:12:18Z scale_manager: backoff active, no new scale actions
```
sre-joan: Root cause hypothesis: autoscaler configured max_capacity too low for current traffic pattern AND tokenbucket regen/unit sizing too small post-rollout. Combined -> backlog and systemic 429s.
eng-ryan: Confirming we changed unit scale from "micro-units" to "nano-units" in ratepolicy config earlier today. That would explain the math error.
ml-runtime: also seeing model fallback thrashing: requests failing on primary model then routed to smaller model which increases concurrency -> extra pressure.
product-ops: Runbook ask: mitigation options? we need quick customer-facing status.
sre-joan: Mitigation plan (live):
  1) Temporarily raise autoscaler max_capacity to 200 and remove scale backoff (emergency).
  2) Enable emergency burst pool "hotpath-burst" and route 30% of traffic there.
  3) Apply immediate tokenbucket emergency tweak: multiply regen by 100x for "standard" tier and set allow_burst=true.
  4) Rollback tier mapping change if config change is confirmed.
  5) Post-mitigation: tune token unit definition and run controlled canary.
infra-oncall (Abe): Executing step 1 & 2 now.
deploy-bot: Triggered job: terraform apply -var="scale_max=200" for cluster hotpath-prod (job id job-7720)
infra-oncall (Abe): Job started: job-7720. Also creating emergency pool from reserved images: kc scale --replicas=24 deployment/hotpath-burst -n prod
infra-oncall (Abe): Step 1 complete: autoscaler max_capacity = 200. Step 2: hotpath-burst pool spun up (24 nodes). Routing rule applied (30% to hotpath-burst) via traffic-router v2.
sre-joan: Applying tokenbucket emergency tweak:
```
PATCH /config/ratepolicy/tiers/standard
{ "regen_multiplier": 100, "allow_burst": true }
```
sre-joan: Patch applied.
ml-runtime: Metrics update: queue dropped from 12.4k -> 1.1k in 4m after burst pool + regen tweak. 429s down from 7% -> 0.9%.
eng-ryan: Rolling back tier mapping change now to be safe: curl -X POST https://config.api/rollback/tier-mapping -d '{"to": "prev"}'
infra-oncall (Abe): Rollback triggered and confirmed.
product-ops: Customer status: alpha-stream saw error rate go from 18% -> 2% after steps. Sending customer note now. :thumbsup:
sre-joan: Observability check: no more autoscaler max hits, scale_manager now adding nodes normally. We'll keep hotpath-burst up while we complete forensic.
ml-runtime: Tail latency stabilized: p95 -> 420ms. Queue down to ~380. Good signal.
infra-oncall (Abe): Summarizing incident actions for now: increased max_capacity, spun up emergency pool, tokenbucket regen multiplier + allow_burst, rolled back config change. Monitoring.
sre-joan: Postmortem next steps: 1) fix unit conversion bug in ratepolicy rollout 2) add guardrail test for token unit diffs 3) autoscaler alert should fire earlier (queue growth threshold + scale saturation) 4) run capacity DR drill for hotpath.
product-ops: Preparing customer comms + SLA impact assessment. Will attach timeline and affected tenants.
incident-bot: Incident update posted to #status-page: INCIDENT-1768123456 - GPU saturation -> ratepolicy misconfig; mitigated; follow-up required.
infra-oncall (Abe): Leaving handoff to SRE-Joan for root cause deep-dive and postmortem. Oncall out in 10m. If anything spikes, ping me.
sre-joan: I have the hand. Will open postmortem ticket and collect logs. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: job-7720 completed successfully. Terraform changes recorded in infra-state.
infra-oncall (Abe): Closing handoff. Monitoring low and stable. last check p95 430ms, 429s <1%.
product-ops: Noted. Will share external update in 30m.
eng-ryan: Follow-up action: add automated diff check for unit scale on ratepolicy PRs.
sre-joan: Creating postmortem draft now. Will include timeline, mitigations, config diffs, and mitigation run commands.
incident-bot: Incident resolved (monitoring). If errors reappear reopen thread.
